statement.zh: **标准**：密码模块安全要求（FIPS 140-3）（Security Requirements for Cryptographic Modules (FIPS 140-3)）。FIPS 140-3 的自我定位写在说明一节：「This standard specifies the security requirements that will be satisfied by a cryptographic module utilized within a security system protecting sensitive but unclassified information」，并把分级方式一次讲清——「The standard provides four increasing, qualitative levels of security: Level 1, Level 2, Level 3, and Level 4.」它约束的是模块本身，而不是某个算法。
statement.en: **Standard**: Security Requirements for Cryptographic Modules (FIPS 140-3) (密码模块安全要求（FIPS 140-3）).FIPS 140-3 places itself in its explanation clause: "This standard specifies the security requirements that will be satisfied by a cryptographic module utilized within a security system protecting sensitive but unclassified information", and states the grading at once — "The standard provides four increasing, qualitative levels of security: Level 1, Level 2, Level 3, and Level 4." What is regulated is the module, not a single algorithm.

statement.zh: 为什么要一份模块标准：算法正确不代表实现安全，所以要求覆盖设计与运行的整条链。摘要列出范围：「These areas include cryptographic module specification; cryptographic module interfaces; roles, services, and authentication; software/firmware security; operating environment; physical security; non-invasive security; sensitive security parameter management; self-tests; life-cycle assurance; and mitigation of other attacks.」。
statement.en: Why a module standard at all: a correct algorithm does not imply a safe implementation, so the requirements span the whole design-and-operation chain.The abstract lists the scope: "These areas include cryptographic module specification; cryptographic module interfaces; roles, services, and authentication; software/firmware security; operating environment; physical security; non-invasive security; sensitive security parameter management; self-tests; life-cycle assurance; and mitigation of other attacks."。.

statement.zh: 适用面写在 §6：「This standard shall be used in designing and implementing cryptographic modules that Federal departments and agencies operate or are operated for them under contract.」同段给出两条出路——「Cryptographic modules that have been approved for classified use may be used in lieu of modules that have been validated against this standard.」，以及「The adoption and use of this standard is available to private and commercial organizations.
statement.en: Applicability sits in clause 6: "This standard shall be used in designing and implementing cryptographic modules that Federal departments and agencies operate or are operated for them under contract." That clause leaves two exits — "Cryptographic modules that have been approved for classified use may be used in lieu of modules that have been validated against this standard." and "The adoption and use of this standard is available to private and commercial organizations.

statement.zh: 限度有两处可读出来。其一，它是联邦采购与验证口径，标准把用途限定在「a security system protecting sensitive but unclassified information」；§6 另给两条出路——「Cryptographic modules that have been approved for classified use may be used in lieu of modules that have been validated against this standard.」与「The adoption and use of this standard is available to private and commercial organizations.」。其二，合规与可验证被绑在一起：紧接一句说明「The Cryptographic Module Validation Program (CMVP) validates cryptographic modules to Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) 140-3 and other cryptography-based standards.」——验证计划面向的不止这一份标准，其效力以验证结果表达：「Cryptographic modules that are validated under the CMVP will be considered as conforming to this standard.」。
statement.en: Two limits are legible in the text.It is a federal procurement and validation instrument: the standard frames its use as "a security system protecting sensitive but unclassified information", and clause 6 offers two exits — "Cryptographic modules that have been approved for classified use may be used in lieu of modules that have been validated against this standard." and "The adoption and use of this standard is available to private and commercial organizations." Conformance is expressed through validation: "The Cryptographic Module Validation Program (CMVP) validates cryptographic modules to Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) 140-3 and other cryptography-based standards.

statement.zh: 版本关系写在标题页与说明里：标题页标注「(Supersedes FIPS PUB 140-2)」，日期行是「Federal Information Processing Standards Publication 140-3 March 22, 2019」；正文更明确「This standard supersedes FIPS 140-2, Security Requirements for Cryptographic Modules, in its entirety.」关键词一栏还把国际并行文本列出——「ISO/IEC 19790; ISO/IEC 24759」。
statement.en: The version relationship is on the title page and in the explanation: the title page carries "(Supersedes FIPS PUB 140-2)" and the date line reads "Federal Information Processing Standards Publication 140-3 March 22, 2019"; the body states "This standard supersedes FIPS 140-2, Security Requirements for Cryptographic Modules, in its entirety." The keyword line also names the parallel international documents — "ISO/IEC 19790; ISO/IEC 24759".
